facts.text: The hotel is in Dubai Marina, within minutes of Dubai Internet City, Media City, golf clubs and malls.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the renowned Dubai Marina, our Dubai family hotel is near the city center and within minutes of Dubai Internet City, Media City, golf clubs, malls, and more.

facts.text: The hotel is located steps away from The Walk at JBR, with restaurants and bars overlooking Dubai Marina.
facts.excerpt: Located steps away from The Walk at JBR, Grosvenor House, a Luxury Collection Hotel features a variety of elegant restaurants and bars overlooking Dubai Marina.

facts.text: The hotel's twin towers are an instantly recognizable landmark in Dubai Marina.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s glittering twin towers are an instantly recognizable landmark in the Dubai Marina.

facts.text: The hotel complex is set apart by its blue lights and unique architectural designs.
facts.excerpt: Set apart by its blue lights and unique architectural designs

facts.text: Rooms combine marble floors, natural hues, modern decor and large windows overlooking turquoise waters.
facts.excerpt: Fusing marble floors, natural hues, modern décor, and large windows overlooking turquoise waters

facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of Dubai Marina, the Arabian Sea or Palm Jumeirah.
facts.excerpt: The visual splendor continues through floor-to-ceiling windows, which frame breathtaking panoramas of the glittering Dubai Marina, the azure Arabian Sea, or the legendary Palm Jumeirah.

facts.text: Select rooms have a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Select rooms further elevate your stay with a private balcony, offering a secluded vantage point for these stunning vistas.

facts.text: Rooms and suites come with on-call butler service.
facts.excerpt: complimentary WiFi and attentive on-call 5-star butler service

facts.text: One-bedroom suites have Dubai Marina views, a living room and a fully equipped kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Our one-bedroom suites reflect the signature grandeur of Grosvenor House featuring Dubai Marina Views, living Room and fully equipped kitchen.

facts.text: The Royal Suites are on the 9th and 10th floors and include a lounge area, kitchenette, dining area and master suite.
facts.excerpt: These impressive suites are located on the 9th and 10th floors and include a lounge area, kitchenette, dining area and a stunning master suite.

facts.text: Guests have access to the private beach at Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa.
facts.excerpt: plus access to the private beach at Le Royal Méridien Beach Resort & Spa.

facts.text: There is a fully equipped gym in each tower.
facts.excerpt: with a fully equipped gym in each tower

facts.text: Sanara Spa is a wellness sanctuary inspired by ancient healing and the seven chakras.
facts.excerpt: Sanara Spa is a tranquil wellness sanctuary inspired by ancient healing and the seven chakras.

facts.text: Sanara Spa blends holistic therapies with modern practices.
facts.excerpt: It blends holistic therapies with modern practices, offering personalized experiences that promote relaxation, balance, and overall wellbeing.

facts.text: Level 5 is a business and leisure lounge on the fifth floor of Tower Two.
facts.excerpt: Level 5 is a privileged business and leisure lounge located on the fifth floor of Grosvenor House Tower Two.

facts.text: The Level 5 lounge has a dedicated family lounge for younger guests.
facts.excerpt: A dedicated family lounge caters exclusively to younger guests, allowing families to relax in a comfortable, family-friendly environment.

facts.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge is available 24 hours a day and is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.
facts.excerpt: Available 24 hours a day, our Luxury Collection Concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert proudly wearing the "Les Clefs d’Or,"

facts.text: City Social by Jason Atherton is on the 43rd floor and serves European cuisine with a focus on wood-fired dishes, with a bar overlooking Palm Jumeirah.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 43rd floor, City Social by Jason Atherton serves European cuisine with a focus on wood-fired dishes, complemented by a beautiful bar overlooking Palm Jumeirah.

facts.text: 7 Tales is a Japanese-inspired speakeasy bar on the 44th floor.
facts.excerpt: Discover our Japanese restaurant in Dubai, a Japanese-inspired speakeasy bar on the 44th floor of our hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is Green Globe Certified.
facts.excerpt: Green Globe Certified

facts.text: The property has two outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: boasts two gyms, two outdoor pools, and a serene spa

facts.text: The property has a terrace pool.
facts.excerpt: a fully equipped gym in each tower, a terrace pool, plus access

facts.text: Level 5 is the largest facility of its kind in the UAE.
facts.excerpt: Level 5 is the largest facility of its kind in the UAE

facts.text: Indego by Vineet showcases Chef Vineet Bhatia's Michelin Star-winning Indian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Indego By Vineet, an Indian restaurant in Dubai, showcases Chef Patron Vineet Bhatia’s Michelin Star-winning take on traditional Indian cuisine.
